company_profile: Anthropic is an AI safety company that builds the Claude models and works with enterprises, system integrators and cloud partners to deploy them.
title: Applied AI Architect
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years taking ML and LLM systems from prototype to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Has delivered technical POCs and consulting for 15+ clients, translating requirements between business and engineering teams and designing GenAI solutions with Claude, LangGraph agents and RAG. Builds on GCP and Azure with FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes, with evaluation and observability built in. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Enterprise GenAI Reference Architectures
bullets: Built reusable reference architectures for enterprise GenAI use cases such as document extraction and RAG assistants, pairing Claude with LangGraph agents, tool use and cloud deployment templates.
Evaluated each pattern with automated LLM evals and tracing on sample workloads, and packaged them as Terraform, Docker and FastAPI starter kits for engineering teams.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Applied AI Architect role on the Partnerships team. My career has sat on both sides of the table: building LLM and ML systems in production, and turning client requirements into POCs that teams could actually adopt. The thread through it is helping other people get real systems live.

Anthropic's work on reliable, steerable AI is why I build on Claude today, and helping partners deploy it well is how that care reaches many customers at once. That multiplier is what draws me to partnerships. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Munich together and settle there long term.

I would bring builder credibility that partner engineers respect. At Viavi I delivered POCs and consulting for 15+ clients across 3+ platforms, and 7 of my prototypes moved into production or paid work. At United Health Group I deployed a lab-extraction agent on Claude Opus 4.7 with Amazon Textract, handling about 1,800 lab documents.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Teaching and enabling others is what I enjoy most, whether that is a classroom or a partner's engineering team. I would be glad to talk about the role.
